what: Hayward Executive Airport (FAA HWD, ICAO KHWD) airport data set for Hayward Live 3D: runways (FAA NASR), taxiways / taxilanes / aprons / holding positions / helipads / hangars / buildings (OpenStreetMap, checked and locally moved onto USDA NAIP paint), hot spots (FAA AL-5015, inferred geometry), parking spots (NAIP tie-down tees, adsb.lol parked stays, OSM helipads).
licence: ODbL 1.0 - this file is a Derivative Database of OpenStreetMap ((c) OpenStreetMap contributors) and of adsb.lol data, made available under the Open Database License 1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/); FAA and USDA NAIP inputs are U.S. public domain. See docs/ATTRIBUTION.md
attribution: Contains information from ADSB.lol (https://adsb.lol), made available under the ODbL 1.0
Imagery measurements: USDA NAIP 2024 / 2022 (USDA FPAC-BC Geospatial Enterprise Operations), public domain
FAA NASR (cycle 2026-10-29), Chart Supplement SW (29 Oct 2026), airport diagram AL-5015 (cycle 2611), AC 150/5300-13B Chg 1, AC 150/5340-1M Chg 1 - U.S. Government works
generator: tools/build_airport.py (deterministic; run it to rebuild; tools/check_airport.py checks it)

nasr.what: FAA NASR 28-day subscription, cycle effective 2026-10-29 (APT_BASE, APT_RWY, APT_RWY_END, APT_RMK, ATC, FRQ)
nasr.licence: U.S. Government work (17 U.S.C. 105), public domain

cs.what: FAA Chart Supplement Southwest U.S., 29 OCT 2026 - 24 DEC 2026, HAYWARD EXEC (HWD) entry + hot spot list

al5015.what: FAA airport diagram AL-5015 (FAA), d-TPP cycle 2611 (29 Oct - 26 Nov 2026); schematic, "Positional accuracy within +-600 feet" (TPP legend)

ac5300.what: FAA AC 150/5300-13B Airport Design, Change 1 (8/16/2024, errata 4/3/2025): Table 4-1, Table 5-1, Appendix E

ac5340.what: FAA AC 150/5340-1M Standards for Airport Markings, consolidated Change 1 (12/23/2020): para 2.8, 2.9.1, 3.3.4.1

osm.what: OpenStreetMap, database state pinned at 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z (Overpass attic query; same state rebuilt from the OSM API)

naip2024.what: USDA NAIP 2024 CA, 0.6 m, flown 2024-05-20 (tiles m_3712223_se, m_3712224_sw)
naip2024.licence: public domain; credit requested: USDA Farm Production and Conservation Business Center, Geospatial Enterprise Operations

naip2022.what: USDA NAIP 2022 CA, 0.6 m, flown 2022-05-18/19 (Planetary Computer COGs)

adsb.what: own aggregates of the adsb.lol recording 2026-11-04 17Z .. 11-11 13Z (111 h): parked stays, spots, signal starts/ends, run-up/hold stops (no identities, default D1)
adsb.licence: ODbL 1.0 - Contains information from ADSB.lol (https://adsb.lol), made available under the ODbL

acd.what: FAA Aircraft Characteristics Database (October 2024) wingspans per type, via data/ga_types.json

src_legend.obs: seen in a source: surveyed (FAA), mapped (OSM), measured on NAIP, or observed by ADS-B
src_legend.inf: inferred: by a stated rule, from a schematic chart, by eye, or a default

parking_fields.id: kind letter (T tie-down, R ramp, H hangar apron, P helipad) + the rounded position: E/W metres east / west and N/S metres north / south of the ARP; stable as long as the position is
parking_fields.src: role as a parking position: see src_rule (a ramp / hangar-apron spot needs >= 2 independent observations to be obs)
parking_fields.strength: the observations behind the spot: NAIP years with an aircraft, adsb.lol stays (and at most how many aircraft), signal-edge events (max of starts and ends), tee years, merged duplicates
parking_fields.ref_point: what point of the aircraft the position stands for (ref_point_def)
parking_fields.size.max_span_m: AC 150/5300-13B design value: largest span keeping 10 ft from neighbours (tiered equal share), buildings and helipads [inf]
parking_fields.size.capacity_span_m: the same with a 1.0 m gap: the practical size for placing aircraft [inf]
parking_fields.size.observed_max_span_m: widest adsb.lol type seen here (FAA ACD wingspan) [obs]
parking_fields.size.flags: where the observed type does not fit, or no size fits

frame.axes: x = east (m), z = south (m), y = up (m); origin = FAA NASR airport reference point (ARP) of HWD, rounded to 1e-7 deg; exact local tangent plane on GRS80, datum NAD83(2011) [realisation inferred]
frame.y: NAVD 88 orthometric height (m) [inferred from NASR MSL elevations]
frame.ground_y_note: nominal flat ground for code without terrain (mean of the 6 NASR runway-surface points) [inferred]; use the runway profiles on runways
frame.wgs84_note: OSM and ADS-B (WGS 84) are placed with hwd_frame.wgs84_to_world (x += 1.568, z += 0.162)
frame.heading: degrees true, clockwise from north; world unit vector of heading h = (sin h, -cos h)
frame.ring_convention: polygon rings are lists of [x, z]; open (first vertex not repeated)
